data.long_meaning: The name Shivpujan is a combination of two words - Shiv and Pujan. Shiv refers to Lord Shiva, the Hindu god of destruction and creation. Pujan means worship or reverence. Thus, the name Shivpujan signifies the act of worshipping Lord Shiva.
